name: Family reunions
short: Grandparents, parents and children travelling together, at a pace that works for all of them.
summary: Grandparents, parents, cousins and the youngest ones, travelling together at a pace that works for every age.

image.alt: A child in a safari jeep watching an elephant in the long grass

suits.heading: Every generation, one journey.
suits.body: Multigenerational travel is something we plan often. It works when the drives are short, the rooms are close together and each age has something that is theirs.
points: Families flying in from several countries
Children of every age, from babies to teenagers

services.heading: What we look after.
services.body: Everything that makes a big family trip feel easy.

items.title: Rooms close together
items.body: Estate bungalows, whole villas or connecting rooms, with ground-floor rooms for anyone who would rather avoid stairs.

items.title: Group transport
items.body: Vans or a coach with child seats fitted, and drives kept under three hours.

items.title: Something for each age
items.body: An elephant morning for the children, a cooking class for the teenagers, a temple visit for the grandparents.

items.title: A family occasion
items.body: A birthday dinner, a blessing at a temple, or a photographer for the whole family.

items.title: Arrivals from everywhere
items.body: Different flights from different countries, each met and brought to the same place.

shapes.heading: Shapes we often plan.
shapes.lede: Starting points, each shaped to your family.

items.title: One base, many days out
items.body: A large villa near Galle, with day trips planned so nobody is in the car for long.

items.title: Hills, safari and sea
items.body: Kandy, a tea estate, Udawalawe for the elephants, then the south coast.

items.title: A homecoming
items.body: Time with family in Colombo or the north, built around the visits, then a few days away together.

questions.q: Can you help grandparents with limited mobility?
questions.a: Yes. We choose stays with ground-floor rooms and step-free access, plan short walks, and arrange wheelchairs at the airport.

questions.q: We are flying from three countries. Can you coordinate?
questions.a: Yes. Send us each family's flights and we meet everyone and bring them to the same first stay.
